title: Receipt returned by the M365 driver bridge
description: Hub candidate. The driver's result for each op of a plan. plan_sha256 binds the receipt to the exact ops it answered; a receipt for a different plan is rejected whole. Only status ok is evidence; not_found and error never satisfy a step. Driver error text is never stored. run_at must fall between the plan's created stamp and ingest time. Per-op data shapes: site.library {exists: bool}; mail.sent {messages: [{sender, to: [address, ...], subject, sentDateTime}]}, counted only when sent by the owner to args.to with args.tag in the subject between args.since and ingest time; mail.tagged {messages: [{sender, subject, received, attachments: [{name, content | content_base64}]}]}, where sender is the SMTP address from the message body (a value that is not an SMTP address is rejected), content is UTF-8 text and content_base64 is strict base64 of UTF-8 text, and only messages whose subject contains [tm-signoff are read; run_at must carry a UTC offset (a naive time is refused); file.get is rejected until the Graph driver supplies createdBy.

driver.description: pilot: additive within major 1 (decision 0016); written only by teachermodel pilot-sign for generated signers in a pilot store, and never accepted by teachermodel ingest
